body: Monday's update said schools across Delhi NCR had moved classes online. Tuesday's correction narrowed it: only Delhi's primary schools moved online, and schools in Noida and Gurugram stay open. The three buildings are a drawing, not these schools. Not confirmed: how long Delhi's primary schools stay online (the Monday update said until Friday; the correction doesn't repeat it).

media.description: Three school buildings side by side under a hazy sky, drawn in flat colours. The one on the left has a shut door and an open laptop, showing a play button, balanced on its roof like a hat; the other two have lit windows and open doors. Above the picture, in a text panel: "Monday's update: schools across Delhi NCR go online. Tuesday's correction: only Delhi's primary schools. Noida and Gurugram stay open." Over the bottom of the picture, in white capital letters with a black outline: "THE LAPTOP ONLY FIT ON ONE ROOF". A small line below the picture reads: "Illustrative sample · hrizzup-skills".
